label: malicious
signal: URLhaus exact-URL match counts as artifact evidence
note: A forwarded text file whose content is a URLhaus-confirmed malware URL, with VirusTotal returning nothing. Found by a real scan: it read 69/Suspicious because the artifact-evidence cap treated a confirmed exact-URL detection as being about 'an indicator the file merely references'. The link was the point of the file. URLhaus matches an exact URL, so a hit describes that precise resource rather than its neighbourhood - unlike ThreatFox on a domain or AbuseIPDB on an address, which stay contextual.

suspicious_flags: URL uses a raw IP address
